scope: Identity link, fixed SD1 and SP0.8, z plus cr6 smooth and known offset, exact/left/right/forward and reversed finite intervals; response prediction and SE at19 new rows.
normal_tests: Static references only, no R required.
encoding: Every bound in accepted inputs/payload is a full-precision string. Mixed numbers and infinity strings otherwise trigger jsonlite character coercion with lost precision, changing exact observations into tiny intervals.
candidate_history: candidate_dense_example.json and candidate_dense_workflow.json preserve the originally rejected mixed-JSON candidate payloads, with actual R errors in candidate_inventory.json. These outcomes reflect changed censor bounds during JSON coercion; they do not establish a model-level restriction on dense censoring. The chosen96-row dataset keeps all four observation types and a reversed interval while isolating the seven pipeline contracts. The inventory captures its source response, coefficients, covariance and derivatives for review.
